[[Splash Damage|Splash]] |ranged_damage = [[File:SplashDamage.png|20px|Splash Damage]]60 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]2 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]25
[[File:ExplosiveRange.png|20px|Explosion Range]]4.5 (Explosion) |speed = 3 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} |attributes = {{Attr|Flying}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gift Bomber''' is one of the final units that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Level 4, replacing the [[Bomber Elf (Unit)|Bomber Elf]]. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It has a spawnrate of 50 seconds. Unlike most other units, the '''Gift Bomber''' cannot collide with most enemies as it is a flying unit. It will collide with any enemy that has the [[Boss]] attribute. The '''Gift Bomber''' will drop present bombs whenever there are enemies in its range, which explode after hitting the ground and deal damage to them. ==Appearance== The '''Gift Bomber''' has pale skin and brown hair. It wears a green shirt with a brown belt and red details, red hat with goggles on top, dark green pants and brown shoes. It flies in a red and gold sleigh that has multiple explosive presents in it, which it throws at enemies. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:UnitGiftBomber.png|175px]] |[[File:ChocolatierGiftBomber.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} |{{Color|Valentines2026|Chocolatier}} |- !Obtained From |[[Christmas 2025 Crate]] |[[Valentines 2026 Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Gift Bomber''' can be quite useful against hordes of enemies that spawn later on during the game. **Since it is a flying unit, it can avoid colliding with enemies, allowing it to deal more damage. *On two-pathed maps, only one '''Gift Bomber''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Elf Camp]]. It will go down a random path. *The '''Gift Bomber''' is a flying unit. Because of this, it cannot collide with most enemies. **Do note that despite being a flying unit, it cannot collide with [[Flying]] enemies, though it can still detect them. **The '''Gift Bomber''' can further collide with enemies that are large, mostly major bosses. *The '''Gift Bomber''' is not affected by defense, as it deals splash damage. **This can make it quite useful against enemies with defense, such as the [[Molten Golem]] or [[Hazmat]]. **While its collision damage is also not affected, there are very little cases where an enemy with defense is tall enough for both of them to collide. *The '''Gift Bomber''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *While it may seem that '''Gift Bomber's''' ability to fly would make it immune to most abilities that deal damage, this is not the case. **Because of this, the '''Gift Bomber''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. ***For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and an '''Gift Bomber''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly defeated. ==Trivia== *The {{Color|Christmas2025|Classic}} skin is based on the [[Sleigh (Cold Ambush)|Sleigh]] enemy from [[Cold Ambush]]. *This is the first and currently the only flying unit added to the game. *The '''Gift Bomber''' is the only [[Elf Camp]] unit to not have ''Elf'' in its name. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''21 December 2022''' -
